notes.title: The beta version will be used to test the online version
notes.notes:
In order to test and release the online version as soon as possible, the beta version game ID will be used to test the online version.

This process will last about 60 days.

During this period, when you download the beta version, the game may be missing a lot of content and cannot be played.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
